Download files using configured mirai daemons

Source: R/utils-download.R
download_run_mirai.Rd

Internal concurrent runner used by download_run(). Distribute URL/destination pairs across the configured "default" compute profile, calling download_run_method() once per pair, then collect and combine the results.

Usage

download_run_mirai(
  urls = NULL,
  destfiles = NULL,
  token = NULL,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2,
  timeout,
  http_version,
  daemons = NULL
)

Arguments

urls

character vector. Non-empty vector of URLs to download.

destfiles

character vector. Distinct absolute destination paths, in the same order and of the same length as urls. Paths must be accessible to both the calling process and all workers.

token

character(1) or NULL. Resolved bearer token added to every request when supplied. Default is NULL.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per file request, including the initial attempt. Must be at least 1. Default is 20.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Request-throttling interval in seconds. Default is 2. Multiplied by as.integer(daemons) before being passed to each worker.

timeout

numeric(1). Timeout in seconds for each request attempt. Required; download_run() supplies 3600 by default.

http_version

integer(1) or NULL. HTTP version passed to curl via CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION: 1L = HTTP/1.0, 2L = HTTP/1.1, 3L = HTTP/2. Required; supply NULL to allow automatic negotiation, as download_run() does by default.

daemons

integer(1). Positive number of workers in the fixed "default" pool. Although the default is NULL, a count must be supplied. download_run() obtains it with mirai::nextget("n", .compute = "default").

Value

An invisible list containing numeric counts success, failed, and skipped, plus character vectors failed_urls and failed_files. The latter contains destination basenames. For valid non-empty inputs, both failure vectors are character(0) when no downloads fail.

Details

The caller manages daemon creation and shutdown. Configure a fixed local pool with mirai::daemons(n, .compute = "default") before use and supply the same count as daemons. Detection and dispatch always use "default", regardless of the active compute profile. Rate scaling assumes that the pool size remains fixed and matches the supplied count; each process has its own throttle state, and token buckets can still allow bursts.

download_run() validates URLs and destinations before calling this helper. Direct callers must supply valid inputs. Each task receives one URL and destination, with the remaining request arguments held constant and show_progress = FALSE. Workers need compatible amadeus code and access to the destination storage; see download_run() for development setup.

Results are collected without early stopping. Handled request failures remain part of the combined summary. After collection, unexpected worker errors, worker interrupts, or connection failures returned as mirai error values cause an error headed "Download worker errors:", listing each affected destination and its error message or code. This happens before aggregation, so no combined summary is printed or returned in that case. Otherwise, download_report() prints the combined totals and warns about failed files in the calling process.

See also

download_run(), download_run_method(), download_report(), mirai::mirai_map(), mirai::collect_mirai()
